svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for Software Development. The product is built in three tiers stepping up and back over a dotted floor. On top is the solid blue screen people use, with a designer's selection box round its lime button. In the middle is the code: three blocks, two marked AI, with the AI agent, a diamond with a star, at work over them. At the bottom is the data, three cylinders. One lime line carries the design decision from the button down through the code into the data. A solid blue Tcules person at the front-right keeps a fingertip on the data tier.
